_README: 图解英文翻译。键是 assets/figures 下的文件名，text 里是「原文 → 英文」逐条替换；aria 是整张图的无障碍描述。跑 node tools/build-figures-en.mjs 生成 assets/figures/en/*.svg。

calculator.svg.aria: How a calculator works: a key connects a wire, the chip runs a program, the screen shows digits with seven little bars

text.按下 3 + 5 = 以后，机器里发生了什么: What happens inside after you press 3 + 5 =
text.它不会思考，只是把「怎么算」提前写死在芯片里: It does not think — someone wrote how to calculate into the chip long ago

candy-tooth.svg.aria: Bacteria eat sugar and spit acid; the acid soaks holes in the tooth's armour; deep enough, it reaches the nerve

text.烂牙的不是糖，是糖喂出来的「酸」: What rots teeth is not sugar — it is the acid that sugar feeds
text.糖越黏、吃的时间越长，细菌越开心: The stickier and longer, the happier they are
text.② 细菌吐酸，把盔甲泡软: ② They spit acid, softening the armour
text.一次一点点，泡久了就脱了一层: A little each time — wear it down
text.③ 洞越来越深，碰到神经就疼: ③ Deeper, until it hits the nerve
text.一次吃完一块糖，比一整天慢慢吃要好——关键不是「吃了多少」，是「酸泡了多久」。: One sweet at once beats one all day: what counts is how long the acid soaks.

canteen.svg.aria: Wrapping dumplings one by one is too slow; one big pot is quick

text.食堂要一次喂饱几百人，比的是「快」和「稳」: A canteen feeds hundreds: it needs speed and safety
text.水饺 / 圆子：一个一个包: Dumplings / rice balls: one by one
text.熟得透、够热、同样的钱更划算: Cooked through, still hot, more for the same money

cloud-float.svg.aria: Three panels: a cloud is countless tiny droplets a gentle updraught can hold; a person is one big lump the wind cannot lift; to fly you need wings that push air, or a balloon lighter than air

text.小水珠会飘，人只会往下掉: Tiny droplets float; people just fall
text.每颗只有头发丝的几分之一: Each a fraction of a hair
text.② 人是一整块: ② A person is one lump
text.或者像热气球，比空气轻: Or a balloon, lighter than air
text.关键不是「轻」，是「摊得开」：同样重量，越小、迎风面越大，风越托得住: Not lightness but spreading out: small pieces catch the wind

copy-paste.svg.aria: Three steps to put a picture into WPS: find it, Ctrl+C to copy, Ctrl+V to paste

text.把图片放进 WPS：三步就好: Put a picture into WPS in three steps
text.① 找到图片，点一下选中: ① Find it, click to select
text.网页上的图片：在图上点右键 →「复制图片」: On a web page: right-click the picture → Copy Image
text.手机上：长按 →「复制」，到 WPS 里长按 →「粘贴」: On a phone: long-press → Copy; long-press in WPS → Paste
text.Ctrl+X 是「剪切」：把它搬走，原来的位置就空了: Ctrl+X is cut: it moves the thing, leaving an empty spot

crab.svg.aria: Female crabs have a round apron, males a pointed one

text.把螃蟹翻过来，看肚子上那块「脐」: Flip the crab over and look at the flap on its belly
text.要抱一肚子卵宝宝，所以又圆又宽: Full of eggs, so it is wide and round

fishoil.svg.aria: A little orange-red capsule of DHA, the building block for brain and eyes

text.橘红色的小胶囊里，装的是大脑和眼睛的材料: Orange-red capsule: material for brain and eyes
text.DHA 就像盖房子用的砖：大脑和眼睛长好要用一点点，但好好吃饭比吃胶囊更重要。: DHA is a building brick: brain and eyes need a little, but eating well matters more.

insurance.svg.aria: Many people pay into one pool; the few who need help draw from it

text.很多人各交一点点 → 攒成一个大池子: Many people each pay a little → one big pool
text.出事的人来领钱: The few who claim draw from it
text.一年真出事的只有几十人，剩下的是成本、准备着明年赔的钱，再剩下才是赚的。: A few dozen claim a year; after costs, the rest is profit.

laputa-robot.svg.aria: The garden robot runs on Laputa's glowing stone; when the city fell it stopped

text.它不是流血死的，是「没劲了」: It did not bleed to death — it ran out of power
text.② 劲儿来自城里的石头: ② Power from the city's stone

mirror-flip.svg.aria: Three panels: light bounces off a mirror like a ball off a wall; light from both hands goes straight there and back, so the left hand stays left; laid flat, the mirror keeps left and right but flips up and down

text.镜子翻的是「前后」，不是左右: A mirror flips front-and-back, not left-and-right
text.光直着去、直着回，没有交叉: Light goes straight there and back — no crossing
text.② 左还是左，右还是右: ② Left is left, right is right
text.③ 平放镜子：上下反了: ③ Flat: up and down flip
text.镜子把正对你的那一面原样送回来；觉得「反了」，是大脑替你脑补了一次转身: Mirror returns the facing side; reversed is your brain adding a turn.

money-why.svg.aria: Three panels: barter was awkward; then everyone agreed on a ticket anyone accepts; you take the goods, leave a ticket, and the shopkeeper trades it for what he needs

text.钱，是大家都认的一张「票」: Money is a ticket everyone accepts
text.一只鸡换一袋米: One chicken for a bag of rice
text.要换的人不一定在: The right person may be away
text.② 于是大家约定一张票: ② So they agreed a ticket
text.钱不是给老板的「礼」: It is not a gift to the shop
text.是换走东西的凭证: A receipt for what you took
text.钱本身不能吃也不能玩，它只是一张大家都肯认的「换东西的票」: Money is not food or a toy: it is the ticket everyone trusts.

moon-follow.svg.aria: Three panels: walk a few steps and nearby trees slide behind you; the moon is so far that its direction hardly changes, so it seems to follow

text.为什么你走，月亮也跟着走？: Why does the moon follow you?
text.几步就到身后: Behind you in a few steps
text.② 树退到身后了: ② The tree is behind you
text.不是月亮在跟着你，是一路上的东西退得太快: The moon is not following; everything else is sliding back too fast

mosquito.svg.aria: A mosquito spits saliva; your body's guards release histamine; the skin swells and itches

text.不是蚊子咬得痒，是你的小卫士在打架: The bite does not itch — your little guards are fighting
text.防止血凝固、堵住吸管: So blood will not clot its straw

pangu-axe.svg.aria: A timeline in three layers: Pangu in the third-century story has no axe; the Ming book gives him an axe and a chisel; today's cartoons copy that

text.那把斧子，是明朝人给他配上的: The axe was given to him by a Ming storyteller
text.只写「天地混沌如鸡子，盘古生其中」: Only: heaven and earth like an egg, Pangu inside
text.天地是他一天长一丈撑开的——靠身体，不靠工具: He held them apart, ten feet a day — his body, not tools
text.明代《开辟衍绎》：左手执凿，右手持斧: Ming retelling: chisel left, axe right
text.这部书第一次给他配上两件工具，「或斧劈，或以凿开」: First to give him tools — cutting with axe or chisel
text.因为说书人要一个看得见的动作：劈开: A storyteller needs a visible motion: splitting
text.斧子成了盘古的「标配」，凿子反而常被忘掉: The axe became his standard prop; the chisel was forgotten
text.所以「斧子哪来的」——答案在明代说书人手里: So where did the axe come from? From a Ming storyteller's hands
text.神话会解释世界怎么来的，却很少解释自己的道具哪来的。: Myths explain where the world came from, rarely where their props did.

plugin.svg.aria: A USB stick carries stuff; a plugin is a socket that adds a skill

text.U 盘装的是「东西」，插件装的是「本领」: A USB stick carries things; a plugin carries skills
text.拔掉以后，东西还在盘里: Unplug it and the things stay
text.插件：给软件加一样本领: Plugin: gives a program a skill
text.比如浏览器装了挡广告插件，就多会挡广告: Add an ad blocker and the browser blocks ads

sleep.svg.aria: Three panels: adenosine builds up while you are awake; while asleep, fluid washes it away; the day's memories are copied into the long-term book

text.困，是大脑攒了一天的「垃圾」: Sleepiness is a day's rubbish piled up
text.所以睡觉不是浪费时间，是大脑在打扫 + 存档: Sleep is not wasted time: it is cleaning plus saving

toys.svg.aria: Old toys were a hoop, a shuttlecock and a beanbag; now it is a tablet

text.爸爸妈妈小时候的玩具：动手做 + 出门跑: Toys when Mum and Dad were little: make it, run outside
text.厂院子里、院子里: In the yard, in the lane
text.一个人、一块屏幕、随时能玩: One kid, one screen, any time

why-scold.svg.aria: Three panels: spilling the water is the mistake; grown-ups worry you will get hurt; the telling-off is about the thing, and liking you has not changed

text.大人批评的，是那件事，不是你: Grown-ups scold the thing, not you
text.批评的是一件小事: It is about a small thing
text.下次可以问一句：为什么不可以？: Next time ask: why can't I?

photo-pink.svg.aria: Three panels: old photos are built from cyan, magenta and yellow dyes; cyan fears sunlight and heat most and is slowly broken apart; once cyan is gone there is too little blue, red looks strong, and the photo turns pink

text.不是「变旧」，是青色先退场 —— 老照片要避光、干燥、别贴窗玻璃: Not aging: the cyan leaves first — keep old photos dark and dry
